<?php
class ReturnIntGet {
    public function __get(string $name): int { echo $name, ":"; return true; }
}
class ReturnFloatGet {
    public function __get(?string $name): float { echo $name, ":"; return 2; }
}
class ReturnBoolGet {
    public function __get(int|string $name): bool { echo $name, ":"; return 0; }
}
class ReturnStringGet {
    public function __get(mixed $name): string { echo $name, ":"; return "ok"; }
}
class ReturnMixedGet {
    public function __get(string $name): mixed { echo $name, ":"; return null; }
}
$reader = new ReturnIntGet;
$selector = "integer";
echo $reader->$selector === 1 ? "I;" : "BAD;";
$reader = new ReturnFloatGet;
echo $reader->floating;
echo ";";
$reader = new ReturnBoolGet;
$selector = "boolean";
echo $reader->$selector === false ? "B;" : "BAD;";
$reader = new ReturnStringGet;
echo $reader->string;
echo ";";
$reader = new ReturnMixedGet;
$selector = "mixed";
$reader->$selector;
echo "M;DONE;";
